## Constrained mode
When the debt service ratio is greater than 0.25 but less than 0.5, farmers consider land use changes on holdings to _any_ other land use (not only forestry as in the survival mode). This is intended to convey a sense that they are more intent on remaining if 'proper' farming (not carbon farming), but that signficant change is a possibility.

The landuse change decision is the same as in [survival mode](03c-survival-mode.qmd) but any land use change is allowed (i.e., they may change to non-forestry uses).

The decision sequence followed by farmers each time step is shown below.
```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
  A((START))
  G["<span style='font-family:monospace'>options</span> &larr; <span style='font-family:monospace'> #123;#125; </span>"]
  J[Add all possible<br>holding conversions<br>to <span style="font-family:monospace;">options</span>]
  K[Weighted draw a<br>holding from choices<br>in  <span style="font-family:monospace;">options</span>]
  L[Convert chosen<br>holding with<br>given probability]
  Z((END))
  A --> G
  G --> J
  J --> K
  K --> L
  L --> Z
```
